observation_method: read-only manual review of public official product pages plus hashes of user-supplied rule/scoring evidence; normalized facts, not a raw-page capture
observed_public_facts: The public eligibility page lists Texas Player Picks access for users 18 or older, subject to account and physical-location requirements.
Player Picks are complete multi-leg lineups; payout is the exact value shown on the details screen and can differ by lineup, projection type, promotions, and other disclosed factors.
DNP and Reboot selections reduce or revert the complete lineup, and ties have separate complete-lineup effects.

For full-game MLB batter More selections, the public Reboot page states that a batter leaving after two plate appearances or fewer may qualify; Less selections are treated differently and can still win.
PrizePicks uses official or named third-party scoring partners and generally does not apply later stat corrections after settlement except discretionary correction of clear platform errors.
